decision: Accept removal of the BF16-only host-constant RoPE synchronization workaround
integration_cleanup: Only experimental comments removed from measured source; no executable changes after measurement.
parent_validation: All 66 legs checked for complete ID equality, token counts, matching record digests, clean contention status, AC power, wheel provenance match and finite positive timing metrics.
ownership: Current dispatch bindings stamp buffer ownership before submission, and allocator free quarantines pending/in-flight buffers until completion cleanup. This protects reused scalar storage; the exact writer in the historical September 4 corruption was not isolated.
retained_guards: Non-host-constant scalar offsets, vector offsets and GPU-provided frequencies retain synchronization. Trig limits, shader arithmetic, and numerical acceptance gates unchanged.
remaining_gap: Full native parity remains unmet: three of six native generated-ID digests match, and all measured native throughput targets remain above the accepted build.
